title: Address Policy Vectors
description: Language-neutral conformance vectors for target canonicalization and the special-range policy (backlog E1-001). The orchestrator is Python and the scope contract is JSON Schema, so the two must agree on what a private target is. These vectors are the shared definition both implementations are tested against.

input.description: The literal an operator or adapter might supply, including forms that are not valid addresses.

in_scope_eligible.description: Whether the value may appear in a scope record at all. Eligibility is necessary, never sufficient: a target must also be listed in the signed scope.
